implementation: Added nullable private product_context_id without historical bulk backfill; INSERT sets it from product_id and UPDATE preserves the effective OLD context through FK SET NULL while rejecting context spoofing or changes.

Replaced the open-enquiry unique key with the stable effective context, kept legacy surviving product pointers readable, and changed start/reuse, RFQ general-thread selection, and collision-safe reopen to use that context.
Preserved the O19-MK05 lock order and eligibility guards, 0069 hard-delete/image cascade, enquiry IDs, messages, statuses, and existing product/general thread history.

testOnlyConcurrencyFollowUp.rootCause: The owned test launched as(second, ...) after acquiring the shop lock, but as() performs JWT-claim and role setup before the target RPC. waitForLockWait accepted any Lock event without verifying the query; the captured set_config query proves the observed backend had not reached start_product_enquiry. run.mjs and helpers.mjs were unchanged between the lane base and failed-run head.
testOnlyConcurrencyFollowUp.testOnlyFix: Prepare the second backend's role before opening the first transaction, and only accept a Lock wait whose query is start_product_enquiry. The two-backend barrier and same-context reuse assertions remain.
testOnlyConcurrencyFollowUp.postFixPrivatePostgres: NOT_RUN_BY_INSTRUCTION; coordinator review required before push
